title: Teeth: staging never into main, no direct commits on staging, rebuild nudge
action: Three teeth per staging-lane D0. (1) worktree merge zero-mutation precondition beside the uat check: when the merged id/branch IS the staging branch (match .bee/runtime/staging.json record), refuse WORKTREE_MERGE_STAGING_FORBIDDEN — no escape flag; remedy: merge the FEATURE branch after its uat gate, staging history is disposable. (2) The commit-side hook guard (concurrent-worker git guard family in hooks/) refuses git commit/amend executed inside the staging worktree unless env BEE_STAGING_MACHINERY=1 (set by the staging verbs when they commit merges); remedy: fix on the feature branch, then bee staging add. (3) After any successful worktree merge to main, when a staging record exists, the merge result JSON carries staging_rebuild_suggested: 'bee staging rebuild' and the text output one nudge line (trigger 3). Tests: staging-branch merge refused zero-mutation; direct commit in staging worktree refused, machinery env passes; merge output carries the nudge only when staging exists.

truths: staging branch can never merge into main
direct commits on the staging worktree are refused
successful merges to main suggest staging rebuild when staging exists
